codeReview.summary: Most of the requested frontend label cleanup landed: the current tree uses neutral panel IDs, the app title is `eta-mu`, and the major panel/button renames are present. However, the feature is still incomplete because user-visible `muse` status messages remain in the chat workflow and the deck panel itself still uses an old title instead of the requested `Particle Deck` name.

issues.description: The feature explicitly required narrative/status text cleanup, but the agent chat lane still renders old `muse` wording to users: `muse fallback active` (line 422), `muse turn signal` (line 432), `muse media action` (line 474), and `muse request failed` (line 689). These are user-visible system messages, so the frontend still exposes terminology this feature was supposed to remove.

The feature description specifically called for renaming the former `Daimoi Presence Deck` to `Particle Deck`, but the panel body still renders the heading `Presence Call Deck`. The outer panel label has been neutralized elsewhere, so the UI now shows inconsistent naming for the same panel instead of the requested `Particle Deck` title.

sharedStateObservations.observation: `refactor-worker`'s frontend verification procedure is not aligned with how this mission records worker compliance: the skill requires `typecheck` and `test_frontend` for frontend features, but this worker handoff marked `followedProcedure: true` while only recording `npx tsc -b --pretty false` plus grep checks. Either the skill or the handoff checklist should explicitly say when validator-owned test/lint steps may be omitted from worker handoffs.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `/home/shuv/repos/fork_tales/.factory/skills/refactor-worker/SKILL.md` says frontend features should run `typecheck` and `test_frontend`, while `/home/shuv/.factory/missions/1e8791af-a113-4b92-81a8-45beb67de026/handoffs/2026-03-13T12-16-11-995Z__strip-narrative-labels__5b6889ec-94b6-4705-92a9-fccedb5457a2.json` records only typecheck and rg commands under `verification.commandsRun` and still sets `skillFeedback.followedProcedure` to true.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The rename/refactor skill should explicitly tell workers to audit both ID-derived panel labels and panel-internal headings. This feature updated the outer label path but still missed the panel's own heading text.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `part64/frontend/src/components/App/WorldPanelsViewport.tsx:87-97` uses `PANEL_LABEL_OVERRIDES` / `panelLabelFromId` for outer labels, while `part64/frontend/src/components/Panels/PresenceCallDeck.tsx:473` still hard-codes `Presence Call Deck`. The worker handoff's `skillFeedback.suggestedChanges` also calls out panel label derivation edge cases.

summary: Review failed: the feature covers most of the requested frontend label cleanup, but user-visible `muse` status strings remain in `useAgentHandlers.ts` and the deck panel still shows `Presence Call Deck` instead of the requested `Particle Deck` title.
